      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-browserskill/src/sessions.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Tracks the bsk sessions this plugin created and the \"current\" session\n * pointer used when a tool call omits its optional `session` arg. The pointer\n * moves to whatever session was most recently started, stopped, or operated\n * on, so a model can run several browsers side by side without repeating the\n * id on every call.\n *\n * Strict ownership boundary (the bsk daemon may be shared with other agents,\n * terminals, or dsh instances): the registry ONLY ever holds sessions created\n * by this plugin's bsk_session start action. Tools cannot see or act on any\n * other session — an explicit `session` argument naming a foreign id is an\n * error, the list tool shows owned sessions only, and stop/unload cleanup\n * can never touch a session this plugin did not create.\n */\n\nexport interface TrackedSession {\n  sessionId: string;\n  /** Stable lifecycle handle, retained even if the short session ID is reused. */\n  requestId?: string;\n  browserInstanceId?: string;\n  startedAtMs: number;\n  /** Always true: only plugin-created sessions enter the registry at all. */\n  owned: boolean;\n  state: \"starting\" | \"active\" | \"cleanup\";\n}\n\ntype NewSession = Omit<TrackedSession, \"owned\" | \"state\">;\n\nexport class SessionRegistry {\n  private readonly sessions = new Map<string, TrackedSession>();\n  private currentId: string | undefined;\n  /**\n   * bsk session id → the DSH session ids that may clean it up: the agent\n   * session that started it plus every ancestor along the seed lineage, so\n   * archiving a conversation at ANY level of the chain reaps its browsers\n   * (see archive-cleanup.ts).\n   */\n  private readonly dshOwners = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string>>();\n  /**\n   * Slots reserved by in-flight starts. reserveStart/completeStart/abandonStart\n   * run synchronously around the async spawn, so concurrent starts can never\n   * both pass the capacity check (check-and-reserve is atomic on the event loop).\n   */\n  private pendingStarts = 0;\n\n  constructor(private readonly maxSessions: number) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Reserve a start slot synchronously, BEFORE spawning.\n   * @throws when the configured concurrency cap (tracked + in-flight) is reached.\n   */\n  reserveStart(recoveredPending = 0): void {\n    if (this.sessions.size + this.pendingStarts + recoveredPending >= this.maxSessions) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `session limit reached (${this.maxSessions} concurrent sessions); ` +\n          \"stop one with bsk_session action=stop before starting another\",\n      );\n    }\n    this.pendingStarts += 1;\n  }\n\n  /** Give back a reservation after a start that never produced a session. */\n  abandonStart(): void {\n    this.pendingStarts = Math.max(0, this.pendingStarts - 1);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a freshly started session, consuming its reservation, and make\n   * it current.\n   */\n  completeStart(session: NewSession): void {\n    this.trackStart(session);\n    this.activate(session.sessionId);\n  }\n\n  /** Own a resource without exposing it to ordinary browser commands. */\n  trackStart(session: NewSession, state: \"starting\" | \"cleanup\" = \"starting\"): void {\n    this.pendingStarts = Math.max(0, this.pendingStarts - 1);\n    // Backstop only: with the reservation protocol above this never fires.\n    if (!this.sessions.has(session.sessionId) && this.sessions.size >= this.maxSessions) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `session limit reached (${this.maxSessions} concurrent sessions); ` +\n          \"stop one with bsk_session action=stop before starting another\",\n      );\n    }\n    this.sessions.set(session.sessionId, { ...session, owned: true, state });\n  }\n\n  /** Publish only after initialization and the daemon claim have succeeded. */\n  activate(sessionId: string): void {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (session?.state !== \"starting\")\n      throw new Error(\"browser start is no longer awaiting activation\");\n    session.state = \"active\";\n    this.touch(sessionId);\n  }\n\n  markForCleanup(sessionId: string): void {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (!session) return;\n    session.state = \"cleanup\";\n    if (this.currentId === sessionId) this.selectCurrent();\n  }\n\n  private selectCurrent(): void {\n    this.currentId = [...this.sessions.values()]\n      .filter((s) => s.state === \"active\")\n      .at(-1)?.sessionId;\n  }\n\n  isUsable(sessionId: string): boolean {\n    return this.sessions.get(sessionId)?.state === \"active\";\n  }\n\n  stateFor(sessionId: string): TrackedSession[\"state\"] | undefined {\n    return this.sessions.get(sessionId)?.state;\n  }\n\n  assertUsable(sessionId: string, toolName: string): void {\n    if (!this.isOwned(sessionId)) throw this.foreignError(sessionId, toolName);\n    if (!this.isUsable(sessionId)) {\n      const reason = this.stateFor(sessionId) === \"cleanup\" ? \"awaiting cleanup\" : \"not ready\";\n      throw new Error(\n        `${toolName}: session \"${sessionId}\" is ${reason}; only stop is available until the session is active`,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Forget a session; falls back to the most recent remaining one. */\n  remove(sessionId: string): void {\n    this.sessions.delete(sessionId);\n    this.dshOwners.delete(sessionId);\n    if (this.currentId === sessionId) {\n      this.selectCurrent();\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record which DSH conversation(s) a freshly started bsk session belongs\n   * to (the starting agent's session plus its ancestors). No-op without ids\n   * — e.g. a start whose caller carried no agent identity.\n   */\n  trackOwner(sessionId: string, dshSessionIds: readonly string[]): void {\n    if (dshSessionIds.length === 0 || !this.sessions.has(sessionId)) return;\n    this.dshOwners.set(sessionId, new Set(dshSessionIds));\n  }\n\n  /** bsk session ids owned by the given DSH conversation (or its descendants). */\n  ownedByDsh(dshSessionId: string): string[] {\n    const owned: string[] = [];\n    for (const [sessionId, owners] of this.dshOwners) {\n      if (owners.has(dshSessionId)) owned.push(sessionId);\n    }\n    return owned;\n  }\n\n  /** The DSH conversation ids owning one bsk session (empty when untracked). */\n  dshOwnersOf(sessionId: string): string[] {\n    return [...(this.dshOwners.get(sessionId) ?? [])];\n  }\n\n  /** Mark an owned session as most recently used (recency order refresh). */\n  private touch(sessionId: string): void {\n    const existing = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (existing === undefined) return;\n    this.sessions.delete(sessionId);\n    this.sessions.set(sessionId, existing);\n    this.currentId = sessionId;\n  }\n\n  /** The current session id, if any. */\n  current(): string | undefined {\n    return this.currentId;\n  }\n\n  /** Owned sessions in least- to most-recently-used order. */\n  list(): TrackedSession[] {\n    return [...this.sessions.values()];\n  }\n\n  /** Ids of owned sessions — the exact set unload cleanup is allowed to stop. */\n  ownedIds(): string[] {\n    return this.list()\n      .filter((session) => session.owned)\n      .map((session) => session.sessionId);\n  }\n\n  /** Whether the session was created by this plugin. */\n  isOwned(sessionId: string): boolean {\n    return this.sessions.get(sessionId)?.owned === true;\n  }\n\n  requestFor(sessionId: string): string | undefined {\n    return this.sessions.get(sessionId)?.requestId;\n  }\n\n  size(): number {\n    return this.sessions.size;\n  }\n\n  /** Shared not-yours error for foreign or unknown session ids. */\n  private foreignError(sessionId: string, toolName: string): Error {\n    return new Error(\n      `${toolName}: session \"${sessionId}\" does not belong to this plugin — only sessions ` +\n        \"created by bsk_session action=start are visible and operable here\",\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Resolve the session a tool call acts on: an explicit `session` argument\n   * must name an owned session (and becomes current); omitted falls back to\n   * the current session. Foreign ids are rejected, never adopted.\n   * @throws on foreign/unknown ids, or when no session exists.\n   */\n  resolve(explicit: string | undefined, toolName: string): string {\n    if (explicit !== undefined && explicit.trim().length > 0) {\n      this.assertUsable(explicit, toolName);\n      this.touch(explicit);\n      return explicit;\n    }\n    const current = this.current();\n    if (current === undefined) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `${toolName} needs a session but none is active — use bsk_session action=start`,\n      );\n    }\n    this.touch(current);\n    return current;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Stop can also reach starting/cleanup resources. If no usable session is\n   * current, default to the most recent owned resource so cleanup is retryable.\n   * A rejected stop never moves the current pointer.\n   */\n  resolveForStop(explicit: string | undefined): string {\n    const candidate =\n      explicit !== undefined && explicit.trim().length > 0\n        ? explicit\n        : (this.current() ?? this.list().at(-1)?.sessionId);\n    if (candidate === undefined) {\n      throw new Error(\n        \"bsk_session action=stop needs a session but none is active — use action=start first\",\n      );\n    }\n    if (!this.isOwned(candidate)) throw this.foreignError(candidate, \"bsk_session(action=stop)\");\n    return candidate;\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * Shared view logic for the observation carriers (the floating overlay card\n * and the native sidebar tab): the store-backed view model (snapshot, focus\n * pinning, elapsed ticker) and the Document PiP pop-out. Extracted from\n * ObservationOverlay so both carriers run the same focus/interrupt behavior\n * without duplicating hooks.\n */\n\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, useSyncExternalStore } from \"react\";\nimport type { SessionObservation } from \"../observation\";\nimport type { ObservationClientStore, OverlaySnapshot } from \"./observation-store\";\n\n/**\n * Auto-follow focus: the most recently touched session, but never yank focus\n * to a session whose latest action failed (errors flag the strip item, they\n * do not steal the stage).\n */\nexport function focusOf(sessions: readonly SessionObservation[]): SessionObservation | undefined {\n  if (sessions.length === 0) return undefined;\n  const byRecency = [...sessions].sort((a, b) => b.since - a.since);\n  const healthy = byRecency.find((s) => s.lastError === undefined);\n  return healthy ?? byRecency[0];\n}\n\nexport function statusOf(obs: SessionObservation): \"active\" | \"idle\" | \"error\" {\n  if (obs.lastError !== undefined && obs.action === \"idle\") return \"error\";\n  return obs.action === \"idle\" ? \"idle\" : \"active\";\n}\n\n/** Minimal Document PiP surface (TS lib.dom lacks it). */\nexport interface DocumentPip {\n  requestWindow(options?: { width?: number; height?: number }): Promise<Window>;\n}\n\nexport function pipApi(): DocumentPip | undefined {\n  if (typeof window === \"undefined\") return undefined;\n  return (window as unknown as { documentPictureInPicture?: DocumentPip }).documentPictureInPicture;\n}\n\n/** Clone the host document's style/link nodes into a PiP window. */\nexport function cloneStylesInto(pipWindow: Window): void {\n  for (const node of document.querySelectorAll('link[rel=\"stylesheet\"], style')) {\n    pipWindow.document.head.appendChild(node.cloneNode(true));\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface ObservationView {\n  readonly snapshot: OverlaySnapshot;\n  /** Pinned session wins while it still exists; otherwise auto-follow. */\n  readonly focus: SessionObservation | undefined;\n  readonly pinnedId: string | null;\n  readonly onTogglePin: (sessionId: string) => void;\n  /** 1s ticker while anything is active (drives the elapsed readout). */\n  readonly now: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether one session is visible on a surface scoped to one DSH\n * conversation: sessions started by that conversation or its descendants\n * (the lineage ancestors ride along on the entry). Untracked sessions (no\n * owner recorded) are hidden from scoped surfaces but stay in global views.\n */\nexport function visibleToScope(obs: SessionObservation, scopeId: string): boolean {\n  return obs.dshSessionIds?.includes(scopeId) === true;\n}\n\n/**\n * The store-backed observation view model. Holds the feed for the component\n * lifetime (refcounted — overlapping carriers never kill each other's\n * stream). `scopeId` narrows the view to one DSH conversation's sessions\n * (the native sidebar tab); undefined keeps the global view (floating\n * card, PiP).\n */\nexport function useObservationView(\n  store: ObservationClientStore,\n  scopeId?: string,\n): ObservationView {\n  const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    store.acquire();\n    return () => store.release();\n  }, [store]);\n\n  const scopedSnapshot: OverlaySnapshot =\n    scopeId === undefined\n      ? snapshot\n      : {\n          ...snapshot,\n          sessions: snapshot.sessions.filter((s) => visibleToScope(s, scopeId)),\n        };\n\n  const [pinnedId, setPinnedId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const pinned =\n    pinnedId !== null ? scopedSnapshot.sessions.find((s) => s.sessionId === pinnedId) : undefined;\n  const focus = pinned ?? focusOf(scopedSnapshot.sessions);\n  const onTogglePin = useCallback((sessionId: string) => {\n    setPinnedId((current) => (current === sessionId ? null : sessionId));\n  }, []);\n\n  const anyActive = scopedSnapshot.sessions.some((s) => s.action !== \"idle\");\n  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!anyActive) return;\n    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [anyActive]);\n\n  return {\n    snapshot: scopedSnapshot,\n    focus,\n    pinnedId: pinned !== undefined ? pinnedId : null,\n    onTogglePin,\n    now,\n  };\n}\n\n/** A mounted metadata watcher is not necessarily a visible screenshot viewer. */\nexport function useThumbnailObservation(store: ObservationClientStore, enabled: boolean) {\n  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const element = ref.current;\n    if (!enabled || element === null) return;\n    // A portal uses its PiP document's visibility, independently of the main tab.\n    const doc = element.ownerDocument;\n    const Observer = doc.defaultView?.IntersectionObserver;\n    let active = true;\n    let intersecting = Observer === undefined;\n    let release: (() => void) | undefined;\n    const update = () => {\n      if (!active) return;\n      const visible = intersecting && doc.visibilityState !== \"hidden\";\n      if (visible && release === undefined) release = store.watchThumbnails();\n      else if (!visible && release !== undefined) {\n        release();\n        release = undefined;\n      }\n    };\n    const observer =\n      Observer === undefined\n        ?       "content": "/**\n * HTTP/SSE exposure of the ObservationService for the client half. \"\";\n  const hostname = /^\\[.*\\](?::\\d+)?$/.test(host)\n    ? host.slice(1, host.indexOf(\"]\"))\n    : host.split(\":\")[0];\n  const isLoopback =\n    hostname === \"localhost\" ||\n    hostname.endsWith(\".localhost\") ||\n    hostname === \"::1\" ||\n    /^127\\.\\d{1,3}\\.\\d{1,3}\\.\\d{1,3}$/.test(hostname);\n  if (!isLoopback) return \"host is not a loopback authority\";\n  const origin = req.headers.origin;\n  if (origin !== undefined && origin !== \"null\") {\n    let originHost: string | undefined;\n    try {\n      originHost = new URL(origin).host;\n    } catch {\n      return \"unparseable Origin header\";\n    }\n    if (originHost !== host) return \"Origin does not match Host\";\n  }\n  if (req.headers[\"sec-fetch-site\"] === \"cross-site\") return \"sec-fetch-site: cross-site\";\n  if (req.method === \"POST\") {\n    const contentType = req.headers[\"content-type\"] ?? \"\";\n    if (!/^\\s*application\\/json\\s*(;|$)/.test(contentType)) {\n      return \"POST requires an application/json body\";\n    }\n  }\n  return undefined;\n}\n\n/** Run the fence; returns true when the request was rejected (handled). */\nfunction fenceRejected(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): boolean {\n  const violation = fenceViolation(req);\n  if (violation === undefined) return false;\n  sendJson(res, 403, { error: `forbidden: ${violation}` });\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * Register the observation routes. No-op (with a console note) when the\n * composition has no web server.\n * @returns disposer removing the routes.\n */\nexport function registerObservationRoutes(\n  ctx: Context,\n  observation: ObservationService,\n  lifecycle: Pick<SessionStarts, \"stop\">,\n): () => void {\n  const webServer = ctx.get(\"webServer\") as WebServerLike | undefined;\n  if (webServer === undefined) {\n    return () => {};\n  }\n  const streams = new Set<() => void>();\n  const disposers = [\n    webServer.register({\n      kind: \"exact\",\n      path: `${ROUTE_BASE}/state`,\n      handler: (req, res) => {\n        if (req.method !== \"GET\") {\n          sendJson(res, 405, { error: \"method not allowed\" });\n          return;\n        }\n        if (fenceRejected(req, res)) return;\n        sendJson(res, 200, {\n          sessions: observation.getState(),\n          available: observation.isAvailable(),\n        });\n      },\n    }),\n    webServer.register({\n      kind: \"exact\",\n }\n        if (fenceRejected(req, res)) return;\n        res.writeHead(200, {\n          \"content-type\": \"text/event-stream\",\n          \"cache-control\": \"no-cache\",\n          connection: res.on(\"error\", close);\n        try {\n          unsubscribe = observation.subscribe(\n            (event) => {\n              write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(event)}\\n\\n`);\n            },\n close();\n        }\n      },\n    }),\n    webServer.register({\n      kind: \"exact\",\n      path: `${ROUTE_BASE}/interrupt`,\n      handler: (req, res) => {\n        if (req.method !== \"POST\") }\n          } catch {\n            sendJson(res, 400, { error: \"invalid JSON body\" });\n            return;\n          }\n          sendJson(res, 200, { interrupted: observation.interrupt(sessionId) });\n        });\n      },\n    }),\n    webServer.register({\n      kind: \"exact\",\n      path: `${ROUTE_BASE}/stop`,\n      handler: (req, res) => {\n        if (req.method !== \"POST\") {\n          sendJson(res, 405, { error: \"method not allowed\" });\n          return;\n        }\n        if (fenceRejected(req, res)) return;\n        let body = \"\";\n        req.on(\"data\", (chunk: Buffer | string) => {\n          body += chunk;\n        });\n        req.on(\"end\", () => {\n          let sessionId: string | undefined;\n          try {\n            const parsed = JSON.parse(body || \"{}\") as { sessionId?: unknown };\n            if (typeof parsed.sessionId === \"string\" && parsed.sessionId !== \"\") {\n              sessionId =       "content": "/**\n * ObservationService: per-owned-session live observation state for the PiP\n * overlay — current action, page url, and a breathing thumbnail identified by\n * an ephemeral frame id. Frames live in a per-session 2-slot ring in process\n * memory (never the durable attachment store). Strict ownership boundary\n * applies throughout: only sessions in the plugin's SessionRegistry (owned by\n * construction) ever get an observation entry, and interrupt/kill paths can\n * only reach children this plugin spawned.\n *\n * Observation traffic isolation: thumbnail captures run through the runner\n * directly (never through the tool-level instrumentation), emit no action\n * events, and never move the registry's current pointer.\n */\n\nimport { createHash, randomUUID } from \"node:crypto\";\nimport { readFile, unlink } from \"node:fs/promises\";\nimport { tmpdir } from \"node:os\";\nimport { join } from \"node:path\";\nimport type { Context } from \"@deepseek-ai/cordis\";\nimport { sniffImageMediaType } from \"./image\";\nimport type { KeyedExecutor } from \"./queue\";\nimport type { BskRunner } from \"./runner\";\nimport type { SessionRegistry } from \"./sessions\";\n\n/** One owned session's live observation record (wire-stable shape). */\nexport interface SessionObservation {\n  sessionId: string;\n  /** Last settled page URL, when any navigation completed. */\n  url?: string;\n  /** Current action ('idle' when nothing is in flight). */\n  action: string;\n  /** Epoch ms when the current action started (elapsed time is client-side). */\n  since: number;\n  /** Latest thumbnail id (ephemeral, plugin-owned; never bytes on the wire). */\n  thumbnailAttachmentId?: string;\n  /** Summary of the most recent failed action (drives the red status dot). */\n  lastError?: string;\n  /**\n   * The DSH conversations this session belongs to (the starting agent's\n   * session plus its seed-lineage ancestors), recorded at start. Scoped\n   * surfaces (the native sidebar tab) filter by it; absent means untracked\n   * ownership — visible only in the global (unscoped) view.\n   */\n  dshSessionIds?: string[];\n}\n\n/** Initial snapshot or incremental change carried to subscribers (SSE on the wire). */\nexport type ObservationEvent =\n  | { type: \"snapshot\"; sessions: SessionObservation[]; available: boolean }\n  | { type: \"upsert\" | \"remove\" | \"reset\"; session?: SessionObservation }\n  | { type: \"availability\"; available: boolean };\n\nexport interface ObservationOptions {\n  enabled: boolean;\n  /** Fast cadence while a session is active or recently was. */\n  thumbnailIntervalMs: number;\n  /** Slow cadence for idle sessions; also the \"recently active\" window. */\n  idleIntervalMs: number;\n}\n\n/** Injectable clock/scheduler bits for tests. */\nexport interface ObservationScheduler {\n  setTimeout: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown;\n  clearTimeout: (handle: unknown) => void;\n  now: () => number;\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_SCHEDULER: ObservationScheduler = {\n  setTimeout: (fn, ms) => {\n    const timer = setTimeout(fn, ms);\n    // Never hold the event loop open for a frame refresh.\n    if (typeof timer === \"object\" && typeof timer.unref === \"function\") timer.unref();\n    return timer;\n  },\n  clearTimeout: (h) => clearTimeout(h as Parameters<typeof clearTimeout>[0]),\n  now: () => Date.now(),\n};\n\n/** Max consecutive capture failures before a session drops to the idle cadence. */\nconst FAILURE_BACKOFF_THRESHOLD = 3;\n/** Current + previous frame, so an in-flight HTTP fetch of the old id still lands. */\nconst FRAME_RING_SIZE = 2;\n\nexport class ObservationService {\n  private readonly scratchNamespace = randomUUID();\n  private readonly observations = new Map<string, SessionObservation>();\n  private readonly listeners = new Set<(event: ObservationEvent) => void>();\n  private thumbnailViewers = 0;\n  private readonly captureTimers = new Map<string, unknown>();\n  private readonly captureInFlight = new Set<string>();\n  /** Only running thumbnails: shared-control reads must not wait behind actions. */\n  private readonly activeCaptures = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();\n  /** Captures intentionally cancelled to make way for foreground work. */\n  private readonly capturePreempted = new Set<string>();\n  /** Number of queued/running model-facing calls that currently outrank thumbnails. */\n  private readonly foregroundDepth = new Map<string, number>();\n  private readonly captureFailures = new Map<string, number>();\n  private readonly lastActivity = new Map<string, number>();\n  /** Ephemeral frame id → PNG bytes. Only the live ring members are present. */\n  private readonly frames = new Map<string, { data: Uint8Array; mediaType: string }>();\n  /** sessionId → oldest-first frame ids, length ≤ FRAME_RING_SIZE. */\n  private readonly rings = new Map<string, string[]>();\n  /** sessionId → sha256 of the current frame (skip republish when unchanged). */\n  private readonly hashes = new Map<string, string>();\n  /** sessionId → last issued sequence number. */\n  private readonly seqs = new Map<string, number>();\n  /** Consecutive capture failures across ALL sessions (daemon-level signal). */\n  private globalFailures = 0;\n  private available = true;\n  private disposed = false;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly deps: {\n      ctx: Context;\n      runner: BskRunner;\n      registry: SessionRegistry;\n      queue: KeyedExecutor;\n      options: ObservationOptions;\n      scheduler?: ObservationScheduler;\n    },\n  ) {}\n\n  private get scheduler(): ObservationScheduler {\n    return this.deps.scheduler ?? DEFAULT_SCHEDULER;\n  }\n\n  /** One-time state read; use subscribe for an ordered snapshot and subsequent changes. */\n  getState(): SessionObservation[] {\n    return [...this.observations.values()].map((entry) => ({ ...entry }));\n  }\n\n  /** Whether the browser side looks reachable (drives the \"browser unavailable\" state). */\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return this.available;\n  }\n\n  private setAvailable(available: boolean): void {\n    if (this.available === available) return;\n    this.available = available;\n    this.emit({ type: \"availability\", available });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to an ordered initial snapshot and subsequent changes. On an\n   * active service, listener receives the snapshot synchronously before this\n   * method returns. Subscribing after disposal is a no-op.\n   *\n   * `thumbnails` defaults to true for compatibility: this subscription counts\n   * as a screenshot viewer for the service's owned sessions. Pass false for\n   * state-only observation. The first viewer starts capture scheduling.\n   *\n   * @returns An idempotent unsubscribe function releasing this subscription's\n   * screenshot demand. When the last viewer leaves, scheduled/queued captures\n   * are cancelled/skipped; an already running capture may finish.\n   */\n  subscribe(\n    listener: (event: ObservationEvent) => void,\n    { thumbnails = true }: { thumbnails?: boolean } = {},\n  ): () => void {\n    if (this.disposed) return () => {};\n    // Each subscription owns its lease, even if a caller reuses a callback.\n    const receive = (event: ObservationEvent) => listener(event);\n    this.listeners.add(receive);\n    try {\n      listener({ type: \"snapshot\", sessions: this.getState(), available: this.available });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.listeners.delete(receive);\n      throw error;\n    }\n    if (thumbnails && ++this.thumbnailViewers === 1) {\n      for (const sessionId of this.observations.keys()) this.scheduleCapture(sessionId, 0);\n    }\n    return () => {\n      if (!this.listeners.delete(receive)) return;\n      if (thumbnails && --this.thumbnailViewers === 0) {\n        for (const sessionId of this.captureTimers.keys()) this.cancelCapture(sessionId);\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  private emit(event: ObservationEvent): void {\n    for (const listener of [...this.listeners]) {\n      try {\n        listener(event);\n      } catch {\n        // A faulty subscriber must not starve the others.\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private put(entry: SessionObservation): void {\n    this.observations.set(entry.sessionId, entry);\n    this.emit({ type: \"upsert\", session: { ...entry } });\n  }\n\n  /** Register a fresh owned session (called from bsk_session action=start). */\n  addSession(sessionId: string, url?: string): void {\n    if (!this.deps.options.enabled || this.disposed) return;\n    const dshSessionIds = this.deps.registry.dshOwnersOf(sessionId);\n    this.put({\n      sessionId,\n      ...(url !== undefined ? { url } : {}),\n      action: this.restingAction(sessionId),\n      since: this.scheduler.now(),\n      ...(dshSessionIds.length > 0 ? { dshSessionIds } : {}),\n    });\n    this.lastActivity.set(sessionId, this.scheduler.now());\n    this.scheduleCapture(sessionId, 0);\n  }\n\n  /** Drop a session (called from bsk_session action=stop). */\n  removeSession(sessionId: string): void {\n    this.cancelCapture(sessionId);\n    this.foregroundDepth.delete(sessionId);\n    this.capturePreempted.delete(sessionId);\n    this.captureFailures.delete(sessionId);\n    this.lastActivity.delete(sessionId);\n    this.dropSessionFrames(sessionId);\n    if (this.observations.delete(sessionId)) {\n      this.emit({\n        type: \"remove\",\n        session: { sessionId, action: \"idle\", since: this.scheduler.now() },\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Give model-facing work priority over the best-effort thumbnail lane.\n   * The first lease cancels a pending timer and gracefully interrupts an\n   * active bsk screenshot; the last release schedules one fresh frame.\n   */\n  acquireForeground(sessionId: string): () => void {\n    if (!this.deps.options.enabled || this.disposed || !this.observations.has(sessionId)) {\n      return () => {};\n    }\n    const depth = this.foregroundDepth.get(sessionId) ?? 0;\n    this.foregroundDepth.set(sessionId, depth + 1);\n    if (depth === 0) {\n      this.cancelCapture(sessionId);\n      if (this.deps.runner.killFor(`observation:${sessionId}`) > 0) {\n        this.capturePreempted.add(sessionId);\n      }\n    }\n    let released = false;\n    return () => {\n      if (released) return;\n      released = true;\n      const remaining = (this.foregroundDepth.get(sessionId) ?? 1) - 1;\n      if (remaining > 0) {\n        this.foregroundDepth.set(sessionId, remaining);\n        return;\n      }\n      this.foregroundDepth.delete(sessionId);\n      if (!this.disposed && this.observations.has(sessionId)) this.scheduleCapture(sessionId, 0);\n    };\n  }\n\n  /** Call after acquiring foreground priority, before bypassing the action queue.\n   * Killing the CLI only requests cancellation; wait for its bounded cleanup. */\n  async waitForCapture(sessionId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {\n    signal.throwIfAborted();\n    const capture = this.activeCaptures.get(sessionId);\n    if (!capture) return;\n    let abort: (() => void) | undefined;\n    try {\n      await Promise.race([\n        capture.catch(() => {}),\n        new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {\n          abort = () => reject(signal.reason);\n          signal.addEventListener(\"abort\", abort, { once: true });\n          if (signal.aborted) abort();\n        }),\n      ]);\n      signal.throwIfAborted();\n    } finally {\n      if (abort) signal.removeEventListener(\"abort\", abort);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Mark an action starting on a session (tool entry instrumentation). */\n  beginAction(sessionId: string, action: string): void {\n    if (!this.deps.options.enabled || this.disposed) return;\n    const entry = this.observations.get(sessionId);\n    if (entry === undefined) return;\n    const now = this.scheduler.now();\n    this.lastActivity.set(sessionId, now);\n    // A fresh action clears the previous error marker (red dot means \"last action failed\").\n    const next: SessionObservation = { ...entry, action, since: now };\n    delete next.lastError;\n    this.put(next);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Mark the current action settling (tool exit instrumentation). Triggers an\n   * immediate thumbnail refresh — action-driven first, timer as fallback.\n   */\n  endAction(sessionId: string, error?: string): void {\n    if (!this.deps.options.enabled || this.disposed) return;\n    const entry = this.observations.get(sessionId);\n    if (entry === undefined) return;\n    const now = this.scheduler.now();\n    this.lastActivity.set(sessionId, now);\n    const next: SessionObservation = {\n      ...entry,\n      action: this.restingAction(sessionId),\n      since: now,\n    };\n    if (error !== undefined) next.lastError = error;\n    else delete next.lastError;\n    this.put(next);\n    if (!this.foregroundDepth.has(sessionId)) this.scheduleCapture(sessionId, 0);\n  }\n\n  /** Record the settled page URL (navigate success / start with url). */\n  setUrl(sessionId: string, url: string): void {\n    if (!this.deps.options.enabled || this.disposed) return;\n    const entry = this.observations.get(sessionId);\n    if (entry === undefined) return;\n    this.put({ ...entry, url });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Interrupt the in-flight call of one session (default: the registry's\n   * current).
